implementer.description: Implements, debugs, tests, and reviews research code while preserving agent-wiki memory hygiene.

wiki-curator.description: Maintains compact project truth in wiki/ and structured registries in knowledge/.

deep-research.description: Finds credible papers, builds literature context, and writes evidence-linked research memos.

reporter.description: Creates dated, evidence-linked project reports for status review and paper preparation.

context-implementer.template:
Use this OpenCode implementer context pack as startup context:

!`python scripts/wiki/contextualize.py --role implementer --no-git --max-lines 180`

Restate the current task and choose the smallest route from wiki/ROUTING_TABLE.md.

context-curator.template:
Use this OpenCode wiki-curator context pack as startup context:

!`python scripts/wiki/contextualize.py --role wiki-curator --no-git --max-lines 180`

Review only routed evidence and keep wiki/ compact.

context-research.template:
Use this OpenCode deep-research context pack as startup context:

!`python scripts/wiki/contextualize.py --role deep-research --no-git --max-lines 180`

Focus on credible primary sources and implementation-relevant literature.

context-reporter.template:
Use this OpenCode reporter context pack as startup context:

!`python scripts/wiki/contextualize.py --role reporter --no-git --max-lines 180`

Create reports only from cited wiki, registry, source, result, and decision evidence.

wiki-lint.description: Run the agent-wiki lint gate and explain failures.
wiki-lint.template:
Run and interpret the wiki lint gate:

!`python scripts/wiki/lint.py`

If it fails, explain the exact issue and propose or apply the smallest fix.

wiki-scan.description: Record a curator handoff from current git changes.
wiki-scan.template:
Record and summarize a curator handoff:

!`python scripts/wiki/scan_changes.py --summary 'OpenCode wiki-scan handoff.'`

Explain which routes the curator should inspect and whether current truth may have changed.

wiki-map.template:
Regenerate the project map and summarize structural changes:

!`python scripts/wiki/build_tree.py`

Then inspect wiki/PROJECT_MAP.md if needed and note whether routing should change.

new-report.description: Create a dated report scaffold. Pass a short title as arguments.
new-report.template:
Create a dated report scaffold for: $ARGUMENTS

Run `python scripts/wiki/new_report.py "$ARGUMENTS"`, then fill it only from cited evidence. Register it and leave a curator handoff.
